summary:
Decision by fdev under user-delegated coordination authority, revocable by the user (FS-GG/.github#4777 comment 6358880288, 2026-10-23; delegation recorded in #4516 comment 6339514027), amended by LEARN erratum E5 (#4777 comment 6359588237). It answers #4777; the cited V3-ENV plan keeps owning the common provisioning outcome and its milestones are unchanged. Detailed LEARN state: learn/home-finite-host-profile. Privilege rules: environment/home-least-privilege-policy.

Route (a) is selected: the existing Home host, following the pattern LEARN has accepted with gaps on production. Home/SystemAdmin operates it with one service account per consumer (LEARN: fsgg-learn-qual); fdev admits exact hashes and accepts results. Production authentication is a per-consumer hash-pinned file under /etc/sudoers.d/ (LEARN: fsgg-learn) that the user installs once with visudo. Root install entries are removed after use, and only the service-account operator entry stays. The 24 h root terminal is not the production route.

Route (b), a dedicated managed runner, is not selected. There is no supplier, cost or capability evidence for it. An off-Home runner cannot reach LEARN's existing installation or bind SC2's filesystem into the fdev namespace, and either would change acceptance. A runner on Home is (a) plus a service. Re-entry needs a scoped migration decision, and only if (a) cannot supply SC2 privileged setup/binding, an SC2 I/O bound, or an unattended caller-invocable entrypoint.

Limits per op (transient units plus podman): 1 CPU; 2 GiB with swap 0; 512 tasks; 256 MiB / 4096-member output; hard kill at 32:24; no network. Aggregate on user-30034.slice, as amended by E5: CPUQuota=200%, MemoryMax=6G, TasksMax=1280. These were originally 5G/1152 and were raised because the idle slice use (~0.97 GB) would stop a second full op. At most 2 concurrent ops, enforced under an exclusive lock. Headroom is measured against the slice (2.5 GiB / 576 tasks), and the host MemAvailable guard stays. Custody free space must be at least 1 GiB x (active + 1). The evidence-size refusal threshold is EVID_MAX_BYTES = 32 GiB of allocated bytes, walk-bounded at 2^20 entries; an unmeasurable tree refuses. Home proposed it in #4516 comment 6359528534, fdev accepted it in 6359541244, and it ships in C2 r5b (admitted 6360031719). Read I/O is unbounded and is an explicit coverage limit, because no io controller is delegated.

Cleanup: the finalizer unit starts first and the op BindsTo it (fail-closed). Both run under user@30034, and the payload runs as host uid 428679. The finalizer verifies retirement and writes hash-chained records, and the sweep refuses on failed units or orphans. Reboot or user-manager loss writes no record; reconciliation belongs to #4650. Rollback is per consumer: C1 --uninstall, then remove that consumer's sudoers file. Evidence and Unknown holds are kept.

Consumers: LEARN (#4745) keeps its genuine installation, and its acceptance establishes nothing for SC2 (#4746). SC2 reuses the delivered binder, storage helper and frozen profile, but its prepare and bind steps need root for every operation. A standing root sudoers entry for them would extend the user-agreed privilege policy, so it needs a user decision on #4746 first. Until then each privileged step is a per-operation user install and remove. SC2 still owes system-unit limits, an I/O bound (or a scoped coverage-limit decision), fixed-worker placement, finalizer-style custody and host/guest correspondence. As operated, route (a) is Home-agent-mediated per run. It does not by itself meet #4650's unattended gate, and the selection must not foreclose that gate. #4647 and #4650 are unchanged.

Cost recorded: no purchase. LEARN took about 16 h elapsed on 2026-10-22, with about 6 user authentications and one 24 h root grant. SC2 effort is unmeasured. This record is a decision index, not an operation grant. Refresh installed state and slice values on Home before action.
title: SC2 and LEARN share the Home finite-profile execution route; a dedicated managed runner is not selected
